div.h1: A fresh link will get you started.
div.p: Your existing connector, if paired, keeps syncing. Ask your Payobook administrator for a new invitation.
Read your local attendance database and send new records to Payobook automatically after each manual Mitaco download.

aside.strong:
Installed on Windows.
Managed in Payobook.
aside.p: IT handles the connection. Your HR team handles attendance and any data questions.

div.h2: Invite someone to set up this PC.
div.p: A private link gives IT 48 hours to download, pair and check this connector. It does not grant access to payroll or employee records.

div.label: Share this private link directly with IT
div.p: Only shown here when created. A new invitation replaces the previous one. A paired connector keeps running when the invitation expires.
Use the Windows computer that holds the Mitaco database. Download the package, extract the ZIP, then open Install.cmd.
You appear to be using a different operating system. You can download here and transfer the ZIP to the Windows PC.

details.p: This pilot package is unsigned. If your company’s security policy blocks it, ask IT to approve it. Do not bypass security controls. Setup installs for the Windows user who will run the connector.

div.p: In Payobook Attendance Connector on Windows, select the local .mdb file and choose Test read-only access. Then enter this address and a pairing code.
div.label: Payobook address
Paste into the Windows setup, then select Pair with Payobook
div.p: Keep this code private. Generating another code replaces the previous unused code.
✓ This PC is paired. No new code is needed.

div.h2: Run a sync. Then let it repeat.
div.p: On Windows, select Sync now. Once the database read succeeds and the queue reaches zero, select Enable scheduled sync in the Windows setup.
Keep the PC awake and the configured Windows account signed in. IT can configure Windows Task Scheduler for the same account to run while signed out.
The website confirms uploads, not whether the Windows scheduled task is enabled. Check the task on the PC and confirm a later automatic sync.

section.div: The PC reported a collection issue. Check Diagnostics on Windows. Already queued records continue uploading when the connection is available.

section.p: The database is opened read-only. Its path and any local credentials stay on the PC.
Staff still download punches from the terminals in Mitaco. This connector picks up the records that reach the local database.
Repeated records are handled by Payobook. Data questions go to HR for review and do not pause collection.

div.footer: Payobook Attendance Connect Setup access is limited to this connector.
